title: Replacing the GitHub runner: Pinnacle (pinnapi) is not answering
body: Pinnacle (pinnapi) failed 22 checks in a row (refused: Refused (HTTP 403): this key is not accepted.) and the scans are not getting data from it. The engine restarted its connection and now ends this job after the scan it is on so a new runner (a new address) starts: 1 of 3. After 3 it will switch Pinnacle (pinnapi) off and tell you.
